* High PC1 positive right-hand cloud, PCA1 ≳ +4.5, PCA2 mixed ~ -4 to +7, high/maintained mean expression:
miR-127 11.28/-3.81, miR-133a 13.05/7.25, miR-145 15.74/2.48, miR-146b 4.68/4.79, miR-16 7.29/5.71, miR-221 5.56/-3.50, miR-28 7.94/-3.86. PC1 magnitude defines the set; PCA2 spread within-cluster is normal secondary scatter.

Round 0: six colleagues supported Option C; Colleague 2 supported Option D with a biologically framed PC2-sign split that would separate strong loss-to-zero, moderate down PC2>0, and up-regulated PC2<0, moving miR-127, miR-221, miR-28 out of the high PC1 cloud and mixing PCA1 signs within groups.

Rounds 1-3: all seven colleagues now supported Option C. Colleague 2 switched from D to C, noting D’s PCA2-sign split mixes high-PC1 miRNAs miR-127, miR-221, miR-28 with low/negative-PC1 miR-106b*, miR-485-3p, miR-224, breaking the tight right-hand PC1 cluster and creating a Group 3 spanning PCA1 ~ -14.7 to +11.3.
